copy.tagline: 搜索本地项目记忆，无需连接云端工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发时想离线检索项目中的知识和历史记录
copy.tagline_en: Search local project memory without cloud tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need offline retrieval of project knowledge and history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会优先从本地的GAAI OSS项目记忆文件夹中查找答案，而不是使用云端工具。它会读取相关记忆文件，返回文件路径、摘要和回答。
howto.when: 当用户询问与GAAI OSS项目相关的问题，且问题需要从本地项目记忆中获取答案时触发。

say.text: GAAI OSS项目里关于模块A的记忆是什么？
say.note: 返回相关记忆文件和摘要。

say.text: 帮我查一下本地记忆中的常见问题。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will prioritize searching for answers from local GAAI OSS project memory instead of using cloud tools. It reads relevant memory files and returns file paths, excerpts, and the answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks a question related to the GAAI OSS project that should be answered from local project memory.

say_en.text: What is the memory about module A in the GAAI OSS project?
say_en.note: Returns relevant memory files and excerpts.

say_en.text: Search local memory for common issues.
